summary: Iteration 19 full white-label SaaS test pass. 37/37 backend pytest cases pass covering Branding (CRUD + uniqueness + audit + public lookup + RBAC), Subscription (catalog + change-plan + dev-mode checkout + super-admin override + RBAC), Branches (CRUD + metrics + Pro plan-gate 402), Message Templates (auto-seed of 7 defaults + preview $var rendering + system-default delete protection), API Keys (Pro-gated 402 + plaintext-once + revoke), and Tenants (super_admin list/metrics/export with sensitive-field stripping + owner 403). Frontend smoke verified on /app/settings/branding, /branches, /templates, /subscription, /api-keys — all five pages render with the expected UI elements (3 color pickers, live preview, Downtown HQ card, 4 email + 3 SMS templates, 4 plan cards with Pro highlighted, API keys table).

minor.issue: Uniqueness logic in routers/branding.py is correct, but the test could not assert the 409 cross-tenant collision because PATCH /api/branding only operates on the caller's own company and there is no super-admin endpoint to set a branding.custom_domain on another tenant. The constraint is verified by code review — collision check exists at branding.py L34-41 and a unique sparse index exists in server.py. Consider adding a super-admin endpoint to override another tenant's branding for QA purposes.

issues: Layout is clean; live preview pane on the right updates with tagline/footer/colors as expected. Public Booking URL field is displayed but read-only — confirm if intended (custom_domain input is presumably in a section below the visible viewport, would be worth confirming visually).

Two residual test rows from earlier runs (`Test integration` still Active, `TEST_key_19` Revoked). Not a bug — test cleanup is best-effort. Consider adding a 'permanently delete' control for revoked keys to avoid clutter over time.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/branding.py: hex-color validation handled via Pydantic Field pattern in deps.BrandingIn — confirmed rejection of 'red' returns 422. Custom-domain uniqueness uses an exclusion query ({'id': {'$ne': company_id}}) — correct, avoids self-collision.

routers/branding.py: upload size guard (5MB) is enforced after read() so the entire file lands in memory before rejection. For production hardening consider streaming or content-length pre-check, but acceptable for current scale.

routers/subscription.py: dev-mode fallback when STRIPE_PRICE_<plan> env var is unset is well isolated and clearly marked with dev_mode=true in response. Audit log entry not written on the checkout dev path though — only change-plan logs. Consider adding `log_activity(... 'subscription.devmode_flip')` for traceability.

routers/branches.py: _require_branches plan-gate is enforced on POST only — PATCH/DELETE don't re-check. Acceptable (can't add new branches on starter, existing ones remain manageable) but worth documenting.

routers/msg_templates.py: _seed_defaults_for runs on every GET /api/message-templates which is idempotent but performs an extra distinct-key query each call. For high-traffic tenants consider moving seed into the tenant-creation hook only.

routers/api_keys.py: hash field correctly stripped via {'_id':0,'hash':0} projection on list. Raw key returned only once on POST with a `warning` field — good UX. SHA256 hashing without salt is acceptable since keys are 224-bit random tokens.

routers/tenants.py: export endpoint strips password_hash + mfa_secret from users — verified in test. Bundle is full-dump JSON; for very large tenants this could be slow. Consider streaming/paginated export for >10k jobs.

whitelabel_service.py: PLANS dict matches the spec exactly (120/220/360/899, 3/6/10/unlimited seats). has_feature() returns False for invalid plan keys via .get() fallback to DEFAULT_PLAN — defensive.

deps.BrandingIn correctly uses pattern=_HEX_COLOR_RE for color fields, so 'red' is rejected at request validation (422). All other white-label fields are Optional and exclude_unset=True is used in PATCH — partial updates work.
Server.py auto-migrates demo company to Pro plan on startup as documented. Verified: GET /api/subscription returns plan.key='pro' for demo owner.

Frontend Layout.jsx nav exposes Branding, Branches, Messages, Subscription, API keys entries — visible in screenshots, ordered after Activity. Settings parent link present. Super-admin nav (Tenants) not tested in UI but backend RBAC is verified (403 for owner).
